title: Toddler in Hooded Coat Outdoors, 1949 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot photograph of a three-year-old child wearing a heavy hooded coat standing outdoors along a walkway in a lawn area with a brick building in the background. Handwritten text on the front bottom margin reads '3 yrs old 3/49', dating the photo to March 1949, capturing a quiet moment of mid-century suburban childhood.
